purpose: compare five leaf-weighting schemes on the step-2 ABC rewrite export

coverage.cuts: only 4-leaf cuts that ABC rewrite evaluates
coverage.excluded_cuts: cuts with fewer than 4 leaves (rwrEva.c skips nLeaves < 4)
coverage.selection: minimum J inside each cut only; no comparison across cuts and no per-node final candidate
coverage.graph: original AIG; levels, required and leaf depths recomputed in this run
